en: A sepia-toned photograph of a baroque-style sculptural group inside a church. The statue shows a winged female angel in flowing drapery standing on a pedestal, leaning forward and holding what appears to be a basin or large shell. At her side is a smaller supporting figure, possibly a putto or child, helping to hold the basin. The background reveals an interior with stone flooring, columns, and dark wooden or painted decorative panels, suggesting a historic European church or chapel. There is a white border around the image, typical of vintage postcards.
